name: components
desc:
Only the kit components, without AppTheme or AppColors.
Use this import in apps that already have ThemeData itself: widgets do not
require no theme configuration and use the default palette until you provide
another via LumenScope or LumenThemeExt.

Complete kit: components + theme (AppTheme, AppColors).
To use just the widgets, without any themes, import
package:lumen_kit/components.dart.

name: LumenOutlineColor
desc:
Alpha that does not erase what the color in the palette already carries.
Color.withValues replaces alpha. scaleAlpha multiplies (a * factor).
outlineAlpha is the contour case: in the dark,
LumenPalette.surfaceOutline is a translucent cyan and the widgets ask for
0.4–0.9 for the border to appear, so this value comes directly. In light
the token is black at ~8% (0x15000000). Replacing with 0.9 turns a black
border. In this case the order is scaled based on the token's alpha, with a
ceiling of 0.28.

name: outlineAlpha
desc: Applies alpha as an outline, preserving the clear token.

name: scaleAlpha
desc:
Multiplies the current alpha by factor, limited to 0–1.
Use on tokens that are already translucent (textMuted, textSecondary,
surfaceHighlight). Opaque accent continues in Color.withValues: the
requested there is an absolute alpha, and 1 * factor would only match it.

name: lumenMenuPositionAt
desc:
Position for showLumenMenu at a global point on the screen (e.g.:
TapUpDetails.globalPosition from a right click).

name: neonMenuPositionAt
desc: Old name of lumenMenuPositionAt.

name: showLumenBottomSheet
desc:
Opens a bottom sheet modal with the neon theme aesthetic (background
gradient, accent border on top and handle).
builder creates the internal content. The isScrollControlled flags,
isDismissible and enableDrag are passed to showModalBottomSheet.

name: showLumenDatePicker
desc:
Opens the default showDatePicker applying the neon theme.
Uses initialDate as the start date and limits the selection to the range
between firstDate and lastDate. accentColor replaces the default
accent and helpText is passed to the Material picker.

name: showLumenDialog
desc:
Helper to display a LumenDialog with showDialog.
Returns the same result as showDialog. barrierDismissible controls
whether tapping outside the dialog closes the modal route.

name: showLumenLoading
desc:
Lock the entire screen with LumenLoadingPanel while task runs and
returns its result.

name: showLumenMenu
desc:
Opens a floating menu with items and returns the chosen value, or null
if the menu is closed without a choice.
Without position, the menu opens anchored just below the widget owner of
context (like the "⋮" on a card). To open at a point on the screen (e.g.:
right click), use lumenMenuPositionAt.

name: showLumenSnackBar
desc:
Displays a styled snackbar on the nearest ScaffoldMessenger.
Reuses the SnackBar from the Material but exchanges the content for a
surface with accent + glow border, in the style of the rest of the kit.
tone sets default color and icon, duration controls display time and
action adds a textual action at the end of the snackbar.

name: showLumenTimePicker
desc:
Opens the default showTimePicker applying the neon theme.
initialTime is the start time, accentColor replaces the default accent
and helpText is passed to the Material picker. use24HourFormat strength
(or turns off) the 24-hour clock; when null, it follows the configuration
of the system.

name: showLumenToast
desc:
Displays a floating toast over the app via Overlay, without depending on
ScaffoldMessenger.
